tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /rdo rje rab brtan ma'i snyan shal phrin bcol bzhugs so// bh+yoḥ khyod sku in+d+ra ni la'i lhun po la/ /pad+ma rā ga'i 'od kyis 'khyud pa bzhin/ /smug nag rab tu 'bar ba'i sku mchog gis/ /dbang drag phrin las kun 'grub ma la bstod/ /pad+ma 'byung gnas rdo rje dbang phyug dang / /mkhyen rab chos rje tshar chen yab sras sogs/ /rtsa brgyud bla mas bka' bsgos nyer dgongs la/ /bdag gis bcol ba'i phrin las bsgrub par mdzod/ /bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor bcas kyi/ /dam chos sgrub pa'i bgegs kun zhi ba dang / /mthun rkyen ma lus phun sum tshogs pa dang / /khams gsum dbang bsdus log 'dren tshar gcod mdzod/ /mdor na deng nas byang chub ma thob bar/ /mi 'bral lus dang grib bzhin 'grogs nas su/ /mchog dang thun mong dngos grub rgya chen kun/ /myur du 'byung ba'i phrin las khyod kyis mdzod/ /ces sog khang gzhis kha na rdo rje rab brtan ma tshar chen gyi phyag bris ma zhig bzhugs pa la snyan shal phrin bcol zhig dgos zhes bsam 'grub gling pa'i sde pa bgres pos gsungs pa bzhin sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' blo gros kyis bde chen bla brang du bris// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 klu sgrub/ rdo rje rab brtan ma'i snyan shal 'phrin bcol/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
